headline: A 2015 joint resolution set noon on January 4, 2016, as the time the second session of the 114th Congress would begin.
what_it_does: This joint resolution sets the date and time for the second session of the 114th Congress to start. Congress must meet on a set day each year, and this law fixes that day for 2016. It does not change any policy, spending, or rules for people.
when_it_takes_effect: The second session of the 114th Congress convened at noon on January 4, 2016.
